Free demo

Try five letters: ب، ظ، ض، ي، ذ, with 100 words, 100 example sentences and 10 short stories. The sample opens in your browser with no account or payment. It is a limited introduction to the full workbook.

Open the free demo

An internet connection is needed to load the online sample. Any saved progress is stored in this browser on this device; clearing browser data may remove it. The downloadable Windows edition is separate.

Languages and compatibility

Version 1.2.0 for Windows 10/11 (64-bit). The interface and guides support 32 languages. Lesson meanings are available in Arabic, English, Turkish, French and Spanish. An optional male voice is planned as a free update; no release date has been set.
